title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Analista comercial
description:
ATIVIDADES:

  • Realizar atendimento a leads e clientes via telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp;
  • Qualificar leads e direcioná-los para as etapas adequadas do funil de vendas;
  • Executar follow-ups estratégicos e registrar interações no CRM;
  • Apoiar a equipe de vendas na elaboração e envio de propostas comerciais Acompanhar a atualização do CRM com precisão e regularidade;
  • Auxiliar na análise de métricas comerciais (funil, CAC, taxa de conversão, etc.);
  • Apoiar o onboarding de novos clientes e alinhar demandas com áreas internas como assistência técnica e logística. 


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Conhecimentos em processos comerciais.
  • Capacidade analítica (interpretação de métricas de vendas);
  • Conhecimento e experiência com CRM;
  • Superior em cursos de engenharia, gestão comercial, comercial;
  • Inglês: Básico. 


REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Vivência no segmento metalmecânico;
  • Conhecimento (tabelas dinâmicas, PROCV, gráficos e relatórios);
  • Inglês: Intermediário. 


BENEFÍCIOS: 

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte ou vale combustível.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).


Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Linguagem de Programação: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark, Shell Script. Fundamentos: DataMesh, Database SQL e NoSQL, Hadoop Ecossistema, Engenharia de Software, Privacidade e Segurança. Engenharia de Dados: Data Ingestion, Data Stream, PRocessamento Paralelo, Processamento Massivo. Arquitetura de Dados: ETL vs ELT, Modelagem tradicional, Dimensional e Hibrido, Estruturado / Não Estruturado, Camada de Dados Brutos (SOR), Camada de Dados Harmonizados (SOT), Camada de Dados Especializados (SPEC), Data Analytics, Data Viz, Data Storytelling. Experiencia com processamento distribuído e de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência em Pipelines CI/CD (codepipeline / githubactions); Conhecimento nos serviços primários da AWS (Storage Gateway, Direct Connect, DMS, Lambda, Glue, RDS, API Gateway)

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.

✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack using (insert tech stack).

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 7+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- Proficiency with React, Express, MongoDB, Node.

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.



### **What You’ll Get**

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Esse vaga precisa de inglês Avançado . VAGA COM INGLÊS FLUENTE Engenheiro de dados Gestão de estruturas de dados, definição de modelos e padrões logidos de dados como unica fonte de informação (data lake com governança de dados ); Experiencia em arquitetura de Dados; Desenvolvimento Python; Experiencia em coleta, transformação e carga de dados (ferramentas de ETL ); Experiência em trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados; Modelagem de Banco de Dados (SQL, Hadoop, MySQL, Redshift, ); Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB ); Integração de dados com outros sistemas Plataforma AWS; Experiência em workloads de missão crítica; Containers (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, EKS Openshift); DevOps (Gitlab; Gitlab CI, Puppet); Cloudformation (Code Build, CodePipeline) Softwares Necessários: API Gateway . Kafka . AWS Lake Formation . AWS Banco de Dados (Redshift, MySQL, Dynam DB,..) . AWS Athena . AWS GLUE ( Crawlers, Jobs, workflow) . AWS Quick Sigth . AWS EMR . AWS Lambda.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: Coletor de Mídia
description:
Responsável pela coleta de dados de programação e veiculações em diferentes plataformas de mídia, como TV aberta, TV fechada, rádio, serviços de streaming, etc.


Atividades :


  • Coletar todos os dias a programação e os intervalos comerciais de todas as plataformas de mídia que fazem parte da cobertura da Kantar.
  • Avisar a área de suporte sempre que houver alguma falha na gravação de um programa ou intervalo, para que possam identificar e corrigir o problema.
  • Informar a equipe de Preços quando houver diferença entre o programa cadastrado no sistema e o que foi realmente exibido.
  • Garantir que o registro dos anunciantes exibidos esteja correto. Se não for possível identificar o anunciante, acionar a área de Pesquisa para confirmar com as agências.
  • Testar e validar melhorias no sistema que impactem o trabalho do dia a dia.
  • Revisar e corrigir eventuais erros identificados.
  • Participar dos projetos da área sempre que for solicitado.
  • Realizar outras atividades relacionadas, conforme orientação do superior.


Escala: 5x2 Rotativa, garantindo 2 folgas por semana e 1 fim de semana por mês;

Horário de trabalho: 14h às 23h

Modelo : 100% remoto


O que é necessário?

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário de Informática (Pcte Office, Edição de Vídeos, etc.)


Desejável :

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando: em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Rádio e TV ou relacionados.


O que oferecemos:

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Salário fixo
  • Ajuda de custo
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Day off de Aniversário;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Convênio com Farmácias;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida: Total Pass; ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana; palestras sobre temas relevantes; vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais.
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Java Fullstack Developer SR
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with a passion for building scalable and efficient applications. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications that meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Perform code reviews.


Essential Skills

  • Proficiency in Backend Java and Java Spring Boot;
  • Experience with automated testing in Java (e.g. Unit Test, Integration Test, etc.);
  • Solid experience with Python;
  • Solid Front-end development experience, especially with React (or any other SPA)
  • Experience with Typescript;
  • Experience with Microservices Architecture;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services-based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience using AWS services;
  • Good knowledge on relational and non-relational databases, be able to work with Postgres and MongoDB;
  • Practical understanding of Git or similar VCS, CI/CD practices, with a preference for GitHub Actions or Jenkins;
  • Good communication skills in English.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with GraphQL;
  • Experience with agile development;
  • Familiarity with Message Brokers (RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, etc);
  • Utilization of monitoring tools such as Sumo Logic, New Relic, Datadog, or equivalent solutions for troubleshooting and logging;


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!


Please upload your updated CV in English!

Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: SAP Fiori
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Dev BTP UI5 Fiori who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain BTP Fiori applications for SAP Dynamic Forms.

The ideal candidate will have 3–7 years of hands-on experience in SAP UI5 development and should be highly skilled in building responsive, scalable, and user-friendly enterprise applications.

SAP UI5 / Fiori: Strong experience in developing, customizing, and extending Fiori/UI5 applications

SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform): Hands-on experience with BTP services, particularly in application development and deployment

Frontend Development: Strong skills in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, XML

UI/UX Design: Experience creating responsive and user-friendly applications

OData Services: Proficient in consuming and integrating OData services; knowledge of SAP Gateway

Development Tools: SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), SAP Web IDE, Git

Version Control & CI/CD: Familiar with GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD pipelines

Performance Optimization: Ability to optimize UI5 apps for performance and scalability

Experience with CAP (Cloud Application Programming) Model on SAP BTP

Exposure to Node.js, REST APIs, or microservices architecture

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Understanding of security concepts (authentication, authorization in SAP BTP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

ID:

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.



Links


  • Nosso Instagram:


  • Nosso site:

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!


Please upload your updated CV in English!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.
